item.text:
**8B.3 Assessment**

Mixed, leaning yes before mid-July 2024. Trọng’s line was translated into real state mobilization: policy priorities, anti-graft enforcement, formal audits, and personnel discipline. But the same campaign also produced bureaucratic paralysis and, after July 18, direct control shifted away from him.

**Supports**
- [Major tasks and solutions to implement 2024 socio-economic development plan](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/major-tasks-and-solutions-to-implement-2024-socio-economic-development-plan-111240108212720274.htm) — Government of Viet Nam, 2024-01-08. Claim: the government set concrete 2024 priorities on macro stability, inflation control, institutional reform, infrastructure, and anti-corruption discipline, showing the program was being pushed through the state apparatus. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `8B.1`
- [Vietnam names acting president after legislature votes to remove Thuong](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-names-acting-president-after-legislature-votes-to-remove-thuong/2009559/) — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-03-21. Claim: the removal of a top official amid the anti-graft drive shows party discipline and elite policing being used to mobilize the ruling network behind Trọng’s agenda. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`
- [Vietnam’s Communist Party reprimands labour minister amid anti-graft campaign](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AIC-INC-16083583/news/Vietnam-s-Communist-Party-reprimands-labour-minister-amid-anti-graft-campaign-46478047/) — Reuters via MarketScreener, 2024-04-19. Claim: the Politburo publicly punished a minister for violations and Reuters said hundreds of officials and executives had already been prosecuted, which is strong evidence of administrative mobilization toward discipline and anti-rent goals. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`
- [Toàn văn phát biểu của Tổng Bí thư Nguyễn Phú Trọng gửi Hội nghị Quân ủy Trung ương](https://baochinhphu.vn/toan-van-phat-bieu-cua-tong-bi-thu-nguyen-phu-trong-gui-hoi-nghi-quan-uy-trung-uong-102240708183856132.htm) — Government of Viet Nam, 2024-07-08. Claim: the speech gave concrete direction for military and defense work, showing he was still trying to mobilize the security apparatus around his strategic line even late in life. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.1`
- [Plan for implementing the Social Insurance Law 2024](https://vss.gov.vn/english/news/Pages/vietnam-social-security.aspx?CateID=198&ItemID=12375) — Viet Nam Social Security, 2024-11-26. Claim: the implementation plan created a steering group, assigned responsibilities, set a roadmap, and required inspection and guidance, which is concrete bureaucratic mobilization. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [Audit standards of the State Audit Office of Viet Nam 2024: Meeting practical and international integration requirements](https://sav.gov.vn/en/Pages/detail.aspx?ItemID=261&l=News) — State Audit Office of Viet Nam, 2024. Claim: the office issued 43 standards for financial, compliance, and performance audits, formalizing oversight and discipline as part of the ruling apparatus. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`

**Cuts Against**
- [Exclusive: Vietnam forfeits billions of dollars in foreign aid amid anti-graft freeze, document says](https://theprint.in/world/exclusive-vietnam-forfeits-billions-of-dollars-in-foreign-aid-amid-anti-graft-freeze-document-says/2088974/) — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-05-17. Claim: the anti-corruption drive froze approvals, delayed projects, and cost aid, which is strong evidence that the mobilization was politically costly and not cleanly effective. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [Vietnam removes third top leader in two months, reshuffles cadres](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-removes-third-top-leader-in-two-months-reshuffles-cadres/2092648/) — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-05-20. Claim: Reuters described upheaval, infighting, and a chilling effect on bureaucracy, which weakens any claim that the apparatus was being smoothly or sustainably mobilized. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`, `7B.10`
- [Vietnam’s top leader Trọng dies at 80, party says](https://theprint.in/world/vietnams-top-leader-trong-dies-at-80-party-says/2181868/) — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-07-19. Claim: his duties had already been transferred on July 18 because of illness, so his direct oversight ended before the second half of 2024, limiting personal attribution for later mobilization. IDs: `8B.3`, `8B.2`
- [Nguyen Phu Trong, who led Vietnam’s outreach and crackdowns, dies at 80](https://www.washingtonpost.com/obituaries/2024/07/19/nguyen-phu-trong-vietnam-dies/) — The Washington Post, 2024-07-19. Claim: the obituary’s mixed framing is the best synthesis I found: anti-corruption and economic dynamism on one side, but tighter state control and politicized discipline on the other. IDs: `8B.3`, `7B.10`, `8B.2`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find a single 2024 Trọng-authored command document that traces the whole chain from ideology to execution with budgets, staffing, and compliance metrics in one place.
- The evidence is fragmented across government resolutions, defense and audit texts, social-security implementation plans, and Reuters reporting on personnel moves.
- After July 18, 2024, attribution to Trọng personally drops sharply, so late-year outcomes are mostly attributable to the party-state machine rather than him as an active ruler.
